name: gan-driver
description: Independent GAN Gen4 decoder, kept as the test oracle the linked protocol layer is measured against; plus a diagnostic CLI. The CLI and its `blew` transport are macOS-only dev tooling and have no tests — they need a physical cube — so nothing that ships depends on them; the decoder under src/gen4 and src/mac.ts is what the gate covers.

scripts.lint: biome check src tests scripts && eslint src
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run coverage
